description: Van Woustraat 42-46 (1885): 5.2-6 m shop-street fronts of a shop and three upper storeys of dark red-brown brick; three axes of white T-windows under segmental heads with a dark rubbed-brick ring and a white keystone; white sills; a white plain frieze and cornice at 14.0 m; one white pediment dormer with a hoist beam over the middle axis

match.note: Van Woustraat 42-46 (1885); cornice 14.0-14.2 m on the 2023-01-03 strip at a 2.44 m camera height, 3DBAG eaves 13.7-14.4 m

pediment-dormer.note: 32-46: one white dormer 1.8 m wide over the middle axis, 14.1-15.6 m, pediment and hoist beam (its low side cheeks are not drawn)

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop

rhythm.roofline: white frieze and cornice at 14.0 m, one pediment dormer with a hoist beam
schemaLimits: the sculpted keystone heads of 44 are plain blocks
the dormer's low side cheeks are not drawn
